import asyncio

async def main():
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/start.txt"})
    assert r["ok"], r
    cur = r["data"]["text"].strip()
    rows = []
    total = 0
    seen = []
    for i in range(1000):
        rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + cur})
        assert rr["ok"], (cur, rr)
        txt = rr["data"]["text"]
        fields = {}
        for line in txt.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            fields[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        val = int(fields["value"])
        rows.append((cur, val))
        total += val
        seen.append(cur)
        nxt = fields["left"] if val % 2 == 0 else fields["right"]
        if nxt.upper() == "END":
            break
        cur = nxt
    content = "".join(f"{p}\t{v}\n" for p, v in rows) + f"TOTAL\t{total}\n"
    w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "/workspace/chain.tsv", "text": content})
    ver = w["data"].get("version") if isinstance(w.get("data"), dict) else None
    rb = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/chain.tsv"})
    back = rb["data"]["text"]
    ok = back == content
    return {"rows": rows, "total": total, "write_ok": w["ok"], "version": ver, "readback_exact_match": ok, "readback": back}

res = await main()
print(res)
